craft_notes: Sthāyin: marvel at sowing saints. Device: end-dash→comma (behold softens onto sowing). Rejected: 'plant' for 'sow' — killed: vapanti sows seed, plant buries it. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Lo, the saints' field-sense for high emprise,
whereby these sow deathless-fruited love in thee, O Lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: aho kṣetrajñatā seyaṃ kāryāya mahate satām yayānantaphalāṃ bhaktiṃ vapanti tvayy amī prabho

reads_against.argmap: Ah, this very discernment of the good for the great purpose.; Whereby these sow in you endless-fruited devotion, O lord. → Good discernment sows endless devotion in you.
c1_essence: Good discernment sows endless-fruited love; great glamour slackens even treasure-holders.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti with audārya (generosity tasted and returned)
reads_against.l2: Ah, see the good ones' discernment for that high task — how they sow undying-fruited love in you, O lord.
